notes.title: The Trasamire Campaigns 1.4
notes.content:
Version 1.4 of [i]The Trasamire Campaigns[/i] is live. This update brings the following changes:

[list]
[*] Claim Victory button now only enables itself when its requirements have been met.
[*] Reset Zoom button now resets to the map's dynamic starting zoom, rather than the true 100% zoom.
[*] Autosaving now triggers when entering and exiting maps, and after any battles involving the player.
[*] Players can no longer get an extra action from loading an after-battle autosave.
[*] Other minor improvements and polish.
[/list]
As always, be sure to post any feedback and good luck with your conquests!

tags.bug: [*] Players can no longer get an extra action from loading an after-battle autosave.

notes.title: The Trasamire Campaigns 1.3
notes.content:
Version 1.3 of [i]The Trasamire Campaigns[/i] is live. This update brings the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added a dice rolls history button to the bottom of the battle UI.
[*] Campaign AI was being too stubborn in admitting defeats on smaller maps. Fixed. This change should help with Campaigns devolving into 1v1 duels.
[*] Minor tuning and polish.
[/list]
As always, be sure to post any feedback and good luck with your conquests!

notes.title: The Trasamire Campaigns 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2 of [i]The Trasamire Campaigns[/i] is live. This update brings the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added a popup to help direct new players to the in-game Help Pages.
[*] Card fixes: Mislead the Market, Sceptre of Faith, Lateral Thinking, Conjured Camouflage, Phantom Riders, and Come Get Us were triggering defensively instead of offensively. Fixed to match their description texts.
[/list]
As always, be sure to post any feedback and good luck with your conquests!

notes.title: First update is here!
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1 of [i]The Trasamire Campaigns[/i] is live![/b] This update brings the following changes:

[list]
[*] Relaxed requirements for AI's surrender in battles. The new threshold is possession of >65% of the map and >50% of the map's total unit count.
[*] Doubled the starting readiness of battalions on campaign maps. This should make more cards useful sooner.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Master Volume Slider.
[*] Balance improvements.
[/list]
As always, be sure to post any feedback and good luck with your conquests!
